title: GPT 6.1 Sol: Near-Astra intelligence for a fifth of the price
summary: A Hacker News discussion (992 points, 869 comments) about OpenAI's announcement of GPT-6.1 Sol, a new model claimed to deliver near-Astra-level intelligence at roughly one-fifth the cost. The linked article introduces the model, while the comment thread debates its capabilities, pricing, benchmarks, and competitive implications.
